title: Fact Check
synopsis: Kit grades Tracetoon's own summaries against real past work, fixes what leaked or went missing, and puts the evidence right next to every description.
altText: Panel 1: Sam asks whether Tracetoon's summaries are actually right. Panel 2: Kit builds a checklist from real past work and scores 41 out of 48. Panel 3: Glitch is caught smuggling old prompts from earlier PRs and hiding a failed test behind a pipe. Panel 4: Kit shows 50 out of 50 and an evidence panel; Sam is happy.

panels.scene: Sam asks whether the summaries are right

dialogue.speaker: kit

dialogue.speaker: caption
